    RPWHIZ Company – Job Description (General Hiring Format)About RPWHIZ Company

    RPWHIZ Company is an EdTech and career development company focused on internships, skill development, placement assistance, live projects, and industrial training programs for students across IT and Non-IT domains. The company provides practical learning, mentorship, and industry exposure to help students become job-ready professionals.

    Job Description (JD)Position:

    Intern / Trainee / Executive

    Company Name:

    RPWHIZ Company

    Work Location:

    Laxmi Nagar, Delhi / Noida
    Work From Office

    Employment Type:

    • Internship
    • Full-Time
    • Part-Time

    Available Domains:

    • Human Resources (HR)
    • Business Development Associate (BDA)
    • Digital Marketing
    • Social Media Marketing
    • Finance

    • Data Science
    • Cloud Computing
    • Operations & Management

    Roles & ResponsibilitiesHR Domain

    • Screening and shortlisting candidates
    • Conducting HR interviews
    • Maintaining employee records
    • Coordinating onboarding activities
    • Handling recruitment portals

    Business Development (BDA)

    • Lead generation and client communication
    • Explaining company services to students
    • Maintaining customer relationships
    • Achieving monthly targets

    Digital Marketing & Social Media

    • Managing social media platforms
    • Creating promotional content
    • Running digital campaigns
    • Increasing brand awareness

    Finance Domain

    • Preparing financial reports
    • Managing invoices and payments
    • Maintaining accounting records
    • Supporting budgeting activities

    Technical Domains

    • Working on live projects
    • Website and application development
    • Data analysis and reporting
    • Cloud and software support

    Eligibility Criteria

    • Undergraduate / Graduate students
    • BBA, MBA, B.Com, M.Com, BCA, MCA, B.Tech, M.Tech and other streams
    • Good communication skills
    • Basic computer knowledge
    • Willingness to learn and grow

    Skills Required

    • Communication Skills
    • Teamwork & Leadership
    • Problem Solving
    • MS Office / Google Workspace
    • Time Management
    • Professional Attitude

    Benefits

    • Internship Certificate
    • Letter of Recommendation (Performance Based)
    • Live Project Exposure
    • Industrial Training
    • Placement Assistance
    • Flexible Learning Environment
    • Mentorship from Industry Experts

    Stipend / Salary

    • Internship Stipend: ₹5,000 – ₹10,000 per month
    • Performance-based incentives available

    Selection Process

    • Resume Screening
    • HR Round Interview
    • Technical / Managerial Round
    • Final Selection & Offer Letter
